units.source_text: 命里算来，今年是八亲王灾厄最多的一年。

en.t: According to fate, this year was the one in which Prince Hachi would suffer the most misfortunes.

units.source_text: 他很担心，诵经念佛比往常更勤了。

en.t: He was deeply worried, and recited sutras and invoked the Buddha even more diligently than usual.

units.source_text: 他对俗世已无所留恋，专心为后世修福，故往生极乐世界，照理可保无忧。

en.t: He no longer had any attachment to the secular world and devoted himself to accumulating merit for the life to come, so in principle he should have had no fear of rebirth in the Pure Land.

units.source_text: 只是两位女公子十分可怜，实在不忍弃下。

en.t: Yet his two young ladies were so pitiful that he truly could not bear to leave them behind.

units.source_text: 因此他的随从者都替他担心，他们推想：即使道心坚强无比，但到了临命终时倘舍不得两个女儿，正念定会混乱，往生就被妨碍。

en.t: For that reason all his attendants worried for him, thinking that even if his religious resolve was extremely firm, if at the moment of death he could not part from his two daughters, his right mindfulness would surely be disturbed and his rebirth would be hindered.

units.source_text: 八亲王心中打算：只要有一个人，虽然不是完全称心，但做我女婿不会使我失却面子，就不妨将就允许。

en.t: Prince Hachi thought to himself that if there were just one man who, though not entirely satisfactory, would not make him lose face as a son-in-law, he might as well compromise and consent.

units.source_text: 只要真心爱护我的女儿，郑重前来求婚，那么即使有些缺点，我也只当不见，就把女儿许配他吧。

en.t: If he truly cherishes my daughter and comes to ask for her hand with proper seriousness, then even if he has some faults, I will simply overlook them and give her to him in marriage.

units.source_text: 然而并没有人热心地前来求婚。

en.t: However, no one came forward to propose with any real eagerness.

units.source_text: 难得有几个浮薄青年，由于偶然机会，写一封求爱的信来。

en.t: Only on rare occasions did a few frivolous young men, prompted by chance, send letters of courtship.

units.source_text: 他们是借佛游春，赴某处进香，中途在宇治泊宿，一时好奇心起，写封信来求爱。

en.t: They were using a pilgrimage as an excuse for a spring outing, traveling somewhere to worship, and when they lodged at Uji along the way, a momentary curiosity made them send love letters.

units.source_text: 他们推量这位亲王已经失势，有意来侮弄他。

en.t: They assumed that this prince had already fallen from power, and deliberately came to mock and toy with him.

units.source_text: 八亲王最痛恨这些人，半个字也不给答复。

en.t: Prince Hachi detested such people most of all and did not give them even half a word in reply.

units.source_text: 只有那位匂皇子，始终真心爱慕，不到手决不罢休。

en.t: Only Prince Niou remained sincerely in love from beginning to end, determined not to give up until he had won her.
This was probably a bond formed in a previous life.
